koreansayso 한국어공부 03/26/25 🍯 Why do Koreans say “꿀” (honey) all the time? You might’ve seen it in words like: ✔ 꿀팁 = honey tip (= super helpful tip) ✔ 개꿀 = soooo good / lucky / easy win ✔ 꿀잼 = super fun ✔ 꿀조합 = perfect combo But why “honey”? 👀 In Korean, 꿀 (ggul) = honey. And honey = sweet = GOOD. 😋 So when something is sweet, fun, satisfying, or just perfect… we stick 꿀 in front of it! ✨It’s kind of like adding “super” or “golden” in English. → 꿀팁 = golden tip → 꿀잼 = super fun → 개꿀 = sooo lucky / awesome 10
